action.action-desc: Mr. Garamendi (for himself, Ms. Norton, Mrs. Hayes, Mr. San Nicolas, Mr. Brown of Maryland, Mr. Evans, Mr. Blumenauer, Mr. Larsen of Washington, Mr. Pascrell, Mr. Hastings, Mr. Foster, Mr. Bera, Mr. Gonzalez of Texas, Mr. Cicilline, Mr. Welch, and Mr. Carson of Indiana) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To reauthorize the HOME Investment Partnerships Program, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the HOME Investment Partnerships Reauthorization Act of 2020.

section.header: Reauthorization of HOME Investment Partnerships Program
section.text: Section 205 of the Cranston-Gonzalez National Affordable Housing Act (42 U.S.C. 12724) is amended to read as follows:
There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this title—
The Cranston-Gonzalez National Affordable Housing Act is amended—

subparagraph.text: by redesignating paragraph (23) (relating to the definition of the term to demonstrate to the Secretary) as paragraph (22); and
by redesignating paragraph (24) (relating to the definition of the term insular area; as added by section 2(2) of Public Law 102–230) as paragraph (23);
in paragraph (7), by striking Stewart B. McKinney Homeless Assistance Act and inserting McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act; and
in paragraph (8), by striking subparagraphs and inserting paragraphs;

paragraph.text: in section 106 (42 U.S.C. 12706), by striking Stewart B. McKinney Homeless Assistance Act and inserting McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act;
in section 108(a)(1) (42 U.S.C. 12708(a)(1)), by striking section 105(b)(15) and inserting section 105(b)(18);

subparagraph.text: by inserting United States before Housing Act each place such term appears in—
in subsection (a), by redesignating paragraph (5) as paragraph (4);

paragraph.text: in section 215(a)(6)(B) (42 U.S.C. 12745(a)(6)(B)), by striking grand children and inserting grandchildren;

clause.text: by striking paragraph (3), as added by section 211(a)(2)(D) of the Housing and Community Development Act of 1992 (Public Law 102–550; 106 Stat. 3756); and

by redesignating the remaining paragraph (3), as added by the Departments of Veterans Affairs and Housing and Urban Development, and Independent Agencies Appropriations Act, 1993 (Public Law 102–389; 106 Stat. 1582) as paragraph (2); and
in the first sentence of subparagraph (A)—

subclause.text: by striking in regulation and inserting , by regulation,; and
by striking jurisdiction the first place such term appears and inserting jurisdictions; and

clause.text: in subparagraph (F), by striking Banking, Finance and Urban Affairs each place such term appears and inserting Financial Services;

paragraph.text: in section 218(c)(3) (42 U.S.C. 12748(c)(3)), by striking section 224 and inserting section 223;

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (4), by striking the period at the end and inserting a semicolon; and
by redesignating paragraphs (6), (7), and (8) as paragraphs (5), (6), and (7), respectively;

paragraph.text: in section 225(d)(4)(B) (42 U.S.C. 12755(d)(4)(B)), by striking for the first place such term appears; and

subparagraph.text: in subsection (a), by striking Banking, Finance and Urban Affairs and inserting Financial Services; and
in subsection (b), by striking General Accounting Office and inserting Government Accountability Office.
